changelog: 1.0.5-beta.3: Search now groups every season of a show together, in order - searching a show name returns Season 1, 2, 3... (then movies/OVAs/specials) instead of a shuffled list, and result cards now show release years. Fixes the report that users had to type the show name with its season to reach the other seasons.

1.0.5-beta.2: Restores stream resolution on the current rescue CDN routes. Fixes titles failing to load on the released app by raising the in-app probe budget (2MB to 4MB), accepting size-capped reachability, and preferring routes without player-broken segment names. Sub/Dub and subtitles unchanged; verified on the released app runtime and S2.

1.0.4: Vidhawk-independent AniKage rescue source (labelled; used only when the primary has no verified media), byte-first segment validation, probe byte-cap fix for in-app playback, fair provider sweep and stalled-request caps. Fixes the module being fully dark during the Vidhawk media-relay outage.

1.0.4: Rescue routes pass the same positive media validation as primary routes and are never substituted across languages; episodes the rescue sources do not carry remain unavailable with an honest message.
Fresh provider links, available server alternatives, and provider captions with language labels.
Short probes decoded 30/30 Sub and 29/30 Dub samples. These are not full-device playback or spoken-language certification.
Known issues remain: Spy x Family episode 1 Dub returned Japanese audio; Naruto episode 1 Dub failed one seeked media sample. See the release QA notes.

1.0.3-beta.5: Fixes episodes that loaded slowly and then failed with "no verified playable source". The provider needs 17-45s to answer the FIRST (cold) call for an episode and sometimes never answers, while the next call for the same episode is instant - so the play path now asks twice (both servers in parallel, 9s cap per round, 19s budget) instead of giving up after one 10s round. Cold episodes now play via the labelled AniKage rescue; warm episodes are unchanged. Catalogue, subtitles, quality labels and language isolation untouched.
1.0.3-beta.5: Verified: gate ALL_PASSED (one piece 1180 episodes, attack on titan 25, streams 2/2 real TS media); house tester PASSED with 0 warnings; cold episode measured playable at 18.0s.

Sub/Dub and subtitles unchanged; verified on the released app runtime and S2.

1.0.2: Vidhawk-independent AniKage rescue source (labelled; used only when Vidhawk has no verified media), MegaPlay descriptor decrypt, byte-first validation with elevated probe caps, fair provider sweep and stalled-request caps. Fixes the module being fully dark during the Vidhawk media-relay outage.

0.1.0-beta.4: Fixes user reports on downloads and playback - the module now defaults to its muxed video+audio engine (single stream whose timestamps were verified against the manifest across a full episode), so downloads keep their audio and A/V drift is gone; the AniPM engine remains selectable as the alternate server.

0.1.0-beta.3: Fixes from owner testing - subtitles now load in the player on every platform (the AniPM engine's own caption files are unreachable for the app's downloader, so the reachable English caption set now serves both engines and the caption menu works whichever server you pick). The home page is now a full browse experience: a Featured row plus paginated rows and an endless All Anime grid backed by the full 8,900+ title catalogue.

0.1.0-beta.2: First public release of the AniPM engine (ani.pm) - English anime with search, home feed and full episode lists (Sub/Dub flags on every episode). Two playback engines with server switcher: AniPM - adaptive-quality streams with English captions and opening/ending skip markers; MegaPlay - backup server. The module picks a reachable engine automatically per device. Certified: house tester 26/26, real app-runtime Sub+Dub pass, S2 quick Grade PASS.

Owner-approved all-user release. Notes: the AniPM engine serves iOS/iPadOS; other platforms resolve on MegaPlay automatically. A known app-side mid-play issue on some desktop platforms is being fixed in the app itself; Android and iOS playback are complete.

Subtitle tracks unchanged; verified on the released app runtime and S2.

5.0.4-beta.4: Fixed random skipping during playback (disguised .html segments mapped and served as genuine MPEG-TS video/mp2t). AES-CBC player stream descriptor decrypt support, improved fallback rate-limit handling, and normalized subtitle language tags.

Movies and full seasons/episodes with real paginated discovery feeds. Not the default movie source - install alongside Synthetiq Movies.

1.2.0: Fixes the episode failures reported on this source. The site repeats its players in a download section that can carry a mirror the server list omits - those extra mirrors are now used too, so episodes whose three listed servers were all deleted play again instead of reporting no link. No identity change.

1.1.0: Much faster home screen (the newest row and the three themed rows now load together instead of one after another: measured 8.4s -> 1.3s), plus verified server handling. Only the mirror family that can actually deliver video is offered: the site's DoodStream servers sit behind a bot wall, and its cybervynx servers were traced to playlists filled with ad images rather than video, so they are skipped instead of showing an option that cannot play. Source-side note: individual mirrors often go dead at the host - those episodes report honestly that no link is available rather than playing nothing.

1.0.0: First release of the CimaClub engine (w.cimacub.com) - Arabic subtitled movies, series and anime. The catalogue is read straight from the site's own WordPress API (search, newest-episode home rows and a paged feed), so titles and posters come from the source itself. Playback follows each episode's watch page to its MixDrop servers and resolves the player's signed mp4 url per play - those links expire in about four hours, so nothing is cached, and the mirror list cascades automatically until a live one answers. Not the default movie source; install alongside your others.

Owner-approved public release for all-user testing. Source-side notes: some mirror links are already dead at the host and get skipped automatically, and the alternative DoodStream servers sit behind a bot wall so they are not offered. Subtitles on this site are burned into the source video. Playback reports welcome in the Discord support channels.

changelog: 1.0.0-beta.10: Fixes episodes that ended with no playable servers. The module read JSON responses through text(), and the app runtime returns an EMPTY text() for JSON (the parsed value is only exposed through json()) - so every Share4Max mirror list was lost, and only the HTML-based hosts could ever play. JSON is now read through json(); the Share4Max payload parser also accepts both payload shapes, and its phase is bounded to 9s so it cannot spend the whole episode budget.
